messages:
deploy-bot: Started rollout for model-catalog entry `redwood-claude-compat-v2` -> staged canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%. change-window: 2026-04-05 02:00-06:00 UTC. config: `canary=[5,25,100]`, `rollback_on_errors=true` :rocket:
Elaine Park: quick note — we need explicit fallback ordering before moving past 5%. Miguel, can you confirm the priority list?
Miguel Santos: yes, current plan: primary = redwood-claude-compat-v2 (fp16), fallback1 = redwood-claude-compat-v2-q4 (quant), fallback2 = redwood-claude-compat-v1.9 (older model). priority is set by order in catalog.
Tara Nguyen: adding that the KV cache warm-up will matter for latency at 5%. suggest enabling prefix cache prefill for the canary pool.
Miguel Santos: good call. I'll add `cache.prefill: true` for the canary nodes.
Elaine Park: put the SLA guardrails in the rollout notes — rollback if p95 latency > 650ms for 10m or error rate > 1.2% sustained for 5m. Reference runbook: RB-012.
SRE Oncall: noted. I'll attach a dashboard and a smoke alert. If the deploy-bot triggers rollback, we follow RB-012 checklist: scale down, pin traffic to fallback variant.
DevEx Bot: Release notes draft created: "Enable redwood-claude-compat-v2 (canary) with quantized fallback and cache prefill". Link: https://internal/docs/release/1799002468
Miguel Santos: pushing small config change now to set fallback ordering explicitly. snippet:
```yaml
model: redwood-claude-compat-v2
variants:
  - id: redwood-claude-compat-v2
    priority: 0
  - id: redwood-claude-compat-v2-q4
    priority: 1
  - id: redwood-claude-compat-v1.9
    priority: 2
canary: [5,25,100]
cache:
  prefill: true
rollback_criteria:
  p95_latency_ms: 650
  error_rate_pct: 1.2
```
Tara Nguyen: do we want automatic pin-on-failure? I'd prefer auto-pin to fallback1, then human review before full rollback.
Elaine Park: yes — set `pin_on_failure: variant=redwood-claude-compat-v2-q4` for the first automatic action, then page on escalation. keeps traffic on cheaper quantized model while we investigate.
Miguel Santos: implemented pin_on_failure and updated the canary policy. Deploy-bot: please start canary now.
deploy-bot: Canary stage 5% started at 1799002468. Monitoring: latency, error_rate, token_error_logs.
SRE Oncall: seeing a small latency bump in eu-west-1 (p95 from 320ms -> 470ms) but well under 650ms. no errors. :eyes:
Miguel Santos: tracking traces now, looks like longer tokenization for certain prefixes. will add tokenization cache patch if it persists.
Elaine Park: good. hold at 5% for 30m and reassess before 25%. if anything breaches criteria, deploy-bot should auto-pin to quantized fallback and page oncall.
DevEx Bot: I'll schedule the announcement to #announcements after 25% step passes.
Miguel Santos: will post a short rollback note in the thread if we trigger pin or rollback so product can sync.
Elaine Park: thanks team — documenting final checklist and release notes, I'll close this thread when 100% complete. :white_check_mark:
